services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Tonya Walker
reviews.text: AAA dispatch them for a towing service. Alvin called to confirm and give his updated ETA within 10 minutes and arrive shortly after! He arrived at the location FAST, assessed my elderly father's truck and advised him of a possible issue. My dad rode with him and the truck was towed safely. During the ride, my father stated he was cool, with strong interpersonal skills and was very helpful +knowledgeable throughout the entire process. We would highly recommend for future services and to others. In this stressful, unexpected circumstance, he was calm which shifted the energy. They also did a Follow-up call ensuring the level of service and satisfaction. No complaints here! Thank you again

reviews.author: victoria breschel
reviews.text: I hit an object in the roadway that immediately blew out my tire and subsequently damaged my door and the door jamb. When I was safely able to pull over, I called Toyota auto care who wouldn't turn through AAA contacted freedom, Towing and Recovery. Rodak Ragin was the technician that arrived way before the 1-hour quoted ETA. Then he was very quick to get my spare tire mounted and assure me that I would be safe to drive away on the spare. He was very courteous and efficient but most of all he was kind which is what I most appreciated after. Such a crappy thing happening on my way to do nothing when a sunny afternoon

reviews.author: Sam Smith
reviews.text: Wow! I was blown away by the fantastic service rendered today by Dayshawn! I needed a battery start which turned into a rather complicated replacement on my antique car and he arrived punctually, was very professional, friendly, and had my car started up in no time. He even spent a few extra minutes patiently answering some of my questions about the battery. I would recommend his services to anyone!

reviews.author: Julie Clark
reviews.text: Freedom Towing deserves TEN stars, not just five! (Seriously.) Their driver Chris showed up so fast I hardly had time to blink. That was great of course, but the IMPRESSIVE part was that Chris was able to back my van directly into one of the bays at the mechanic’s shop. The employees at shop didn’t think he could do it (because backing up in a very full and busy parking lot isn’t easy) but he backed it in like it was CHILD’S PLAY. Chris was fully professional and very patient while I obtained permission from the shop it to be backed straight into a bay. SUPER EXPERIENCE!!!

reviews.author: Brandea Brown
reviews.text: Alvin was very helpful with getting our family car towed & taken care of. Our car was having issues in the night & he was here quickly to check it out. We appreciate all of the help he provided for us!

reviews.author: Savannah Hamilton
reviews.text: Everything was so smooth and they are really fast and very reliable would definitely call if I needed a tow. I dealt with Azahd, and he has the best customer service. He was there at every step of the process, very reliable.

reviews.author: Anita Saunders
reviews.text: I got stuck in my mother’s long driveway in January after snowstorm and everything was iced over. AAA send Freedom Towing whom I have used several times in the past with much success. Unfortunately the big and long truck they sent also got stuck on side of drive in grass area. A 2nd truck was sent to rescue him and he got stuck also. After many hours they both got free but with much damage to yard and drive from constant wheel spinning. Freedom Towing came back the next day and was able to rescue my car out of yard. Because of weather conditions It took months until all the damage could be taken care of. The relentless, professional effort of one of the owners to make things right for us needless to say was very much appreciated and impressive.

reviews.author: Dina F
reviews.text: My car decided that it was not going to start and I had at least a 5 hour drive ahead of me. I placed a service request for AAA via the app and was assigned Freedom Towing. Robyn called and explained that there was a slight delay with my technician coming to my location, but it was fine with me as I was safe. When Jon G. arrived he helped me immediately! He was professional and super friendly and knowledgeable. I am grateful for Freedom Towing!

reviews.author: t ocampo
reviews.text: I’ve used freedom towing twice this month through my AAA for a flat tire and lockout. They were fast. Friendly. And professional. I recommend their service for any roadside assistance needs.

reviews.author: Smiley
reviews.text: Very unprofessional. I believe his name was Nemo? He showed up with someone else in his truck. The I don’t think he works there, he had on regular clothes. They were drinking beer. I saw a big case of it in the truck. I could smell it on his breath. Nemo had white stuff on and coming out his nose and kept sniffing.

reviews.author: Anne McCrae
reviews.text: With the help of AAA and Freedom, it was an easy process to replace my dead battery. Josh did an excellent job replacing my battery. He was courteous, efficient and kept me well informed on his time of arrival from Newport News to Williamsburg. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Tina Monroe
reviews.text: Not a safe space for LGBTQ. Also will damage your vehicle and then not pay any responsibility or bring you around the Rosie just to give you a Ludacris offer to resolve the issue well under the actual value of the vehicle or damage. Mind you my vehicle was damaged because the driver was too busy trying to hit on me rather than actually do his job and safely latch down my hood of my vehicle. Shady company altogether, and I will be exposing how these reviews are not real

reviews.author: Corgis and Kiddos
reviews.text: I called them on Wednesday because my car would not start and needed jumped. Lady said she'd call when someone was on the way. I waited and waited. Thursday morning I called back and the receptionist said they'd try to get someone out around 10AM, but was not apologetic either. At around 2pm, I ended up calling Coles roadside, who arrived within 40 minutes. It is now Sunday 4 days later and no one has ever called. Highly recommend going elsewhere.

reviews.author: Patty Cox
reviews.text: What a lovely gentleman you have representing your company. First, parking illegally in a handicap parking spot, then calling someone a “dummy” and saying “you see those lights? I can park anywhere I want!” The cherry on top? He flipped the guy off before backing his illegally parked tow truck (with YOUR company name plastered all over it) out of the spot he had no business parking in. Teach your drivers to do better.

reviews.author: Nathan Pogozelski
reviews.text: I had gotten my car towed the 31st of January 2026 and my experience with the company was awful…..i had talked to my tow truck driver and double checked I didn’t have to meet him at the dealer ship where he was dropping my car off….he informed me he will fill out a Dropbox ticket and put my information down….Monday comes around I hear nothing from my dealership so I call apparently my driver left none of my information and just dumped my car there…..and when I went to the dealer to sort that out I went and grabbed a few things I had left in my car and saw the state the inside of my car was….If I’m entrusting you with my I best be damned the inside of my car should not be covered in mud and dirt….

reviews.author: Tina Monroe
reviews.text: I am sharing this review to warn others about my experience with this towing company. On October 18th, 2025 my vehicle was incorrectly loaded onto a tow truck and sustained significant damage to the hood. After I asked for resolution, I was repeatedly given false assurances and unfulfilled promises that the damage would be assessed and repaired. When I visited the location to follow up, the person in charge named Nicole promised to handle it but later offered only $450 to cover the hood and labor an unacceptable amount for the damage. During the tow, the driver identified as Alvin M. made explicit, sexually inappropriate comments to me while I was inside the truck. I felt intimidated and unsafe; I complied with his instruction to reverse my vehicle off the truck because my phone was dead and I was exhausted after waiting three hours for service. I reported the damage and the driver’s conduct to the company the next morning and was told someone would assess the vehicle, but no one ever contacted me. Since October 18th, 2025 I have been given repeated excuses and delays. I would prefer to resolve this without legal action, but because the company has not addressed the damage or the harassment, I am pursuing other remedies. I share this so others in the community are aware: my vehicle was damaged, my concerns were dismissed, and I was subjected to sexual harassment by an employee.

reviews.author: Laura Tripp
reviews.text: Shoutout to AAA and Freedom Towing and Recovery (in Newport News) for responding to our car issue this morning. We thought (and hoped) that it was just a dead battery. AAA identified Freedom Towing as the service provider and shortly after,. Charles from Freedom called and said Ben Jones was on his way to check the battery. Ben showed up, determined the battery was dead (in all fairness, the battery was installed in 2018) and fortunately had one that he could install. Within minutes, the car started and was just fine. Can't thank Ben, Freedom Towing and Recovery, and of course AAA for taking good care of us.

reviews.author: Tonya
reviews.text: I spent “2” days and “3” hours trying to purchase AAA ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE to have my son’s car towed from a repair shop in hampton that was seemingly trying to railroad him. COLES towing was actually parked next to us with a driver inside ready to tow. However we were told to call dispatch. Coles Towing wanted over $100 to take the car only 2.8 miles plus services fees if using a card. We then called Wolfs towing who offered a lesser amount but was unable to provide an eta. Called FREEDOM TOWING got someone on the line who was very professional and treated me like I was their only customer . The fee was adequate and was able to have a driver out in less than 30 minutes who was patient, understanding, professional and proficient . If I can’t get a roadside membership we will always keep Freedom Towing in our list of contacts. Thanks FREEDOM TOWING… keep doing what you are doing . #FREEDOM-TOWING

reviews.author: David Burke
reviews.text: I think the guys name was Nemo, he’s the truth they gave me a eta of a hour and a half he called and told me he’ll be to me in 10-15 mins pulled up and replaced my battery at 11pm forever grateful for AAA and this young man .

reviews.author: Cee Jay
reviews.text: Henry came out to help me when I called AAA for a dead battery. He was quick, knowledgeable, friendly and kind. I felt that he was shooting straight with me the whole time, and I appreciated how quickly he did the work. Also, whoever borrowed his wire brush ought to give it back! Thanks, Henry!

reviews.author: Margaret Hines
reviews.text: Called to let me know when they would arrive showed up on time very friendly very professional not only charged my battery, but also made sure that my battery was still good. Josh did a great job. I was really happy.

reviews.author: Carol Colonna
reviews.text: Neighbor stole spare key to car & copied it. Sits in car Friday & Saturday nights playing radio past two weekends. Sunday when I got in to go to church radio on and battery too far gone to start car. Called AAA and they sent Freedom Towing to jump start battery. After motor going young man warned me to keep motor running for 30 to 45 minutes to be sure battery properly charged. He watched while I ran back in house to get purse. This is what I call super Service!

reviews.author: Devon Wilson
reviews.text: I contacted AAA for car lockout assistance. Josh and another gentleman (who was lovely but I didn't get his name), reached out to me immediately and, even over the phone, sounded incredibly pleasant and kind. They arrived to my location in less than 10 minutes and had me back in my car so quickly. Both gentlemen were so genuinely kind and kept me laughing even after being upset over my car. Absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish. :)

reviews.author: TheConeMan
reviews.text: Would Recommend Solomon Picked up my car without issue and it went quicker than expected. Great Service! Keep up the great work Solomon I hope the tow you did after me went well. Stay safe brother. Thomas will keep you in the loop on when the driver will arrive and if there are any delays. Great Service! Both are hard working employees.

reviews.author: Cherrylann StJohn
reviews.text: B. Jones responded to our call for help, a dead battery. He was there within 10 minutes and after checking out our car’s battery, replaced it with a new one and within 40 minutes, we were on our way home. Mr Jones was friendly, knowledgeable and experienced. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Jack Farmer
reviews.text: Absolutely excellent service! When my car wouldn’t start and I needed to get it serviced, they sent a truck quickly to where I needed it and helped drop my car off with care and respect. Their prices are super affordable without insurance and the service was beyond my expectations for such a low price. Would work with them again!

reviews.author: Becki Young
reviews.text: My daughter's car battery was dead. Called AAA and they sent Freedom Towing out to help. Shawn (sp) was very helpful. I appreciated the way he explained what he was going to do, and afterwards explained the results of the battery test he did. He was very helpful and knowledgeable. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jim Morrison
reviews.text: My van broke down in front of my house (Thank God!). Called AAA & they called Freedom to pick up the van and deliver it to the dealership. Lamar showed up "on time" (he had called me beforehand with a time), did a quick survey of the van and found that the shifter cable had broken off of the transmission. He was polite, professional & VERY helpful. Excellent Service!!!

reviews.author: Kristin Loudin
reviews.text: My first interaction with Freedom Towing was with Justice, who answered my panicked call at 8am, and I instantly knew I had called the right place. I have never had to call a tow truck before, and my car was on the side of 64 - I had no clue what to do. I did a quick google search and picked the location nearest me with good reviews. Justice answered right away and was extremely patient with me throughout the entire phone call, knowledgeable, and proficient at her job. She answered all of my questions right away and quickly assigned me a tow driver to be there in 45 minutes. The driver who arrived was professional and promptly loaded my car up and safely got me to where I needed to be. Thank you so much for the seamless resolution of the horrible start to my Thursday morning.

reviews.author: Kim Hunter
reviews.text: Shawn, the tow truck operator, reached out every step.of the way and even took photos of the vehicle upon delivery. He was so helpful, reassuring and responsive. Justice with the company also did an excellent job in communicating and quickly getting the service call taken care of! Will definitely use them again if needed. Thank you!

reviews.author: Rose Shinkle
reviews.text: Our Jeeps battery was dead.( towing behind motorhome) Called AAA and they sent Freedom Towing out. The office called to let me know they received the call from AAA and a driver would be there in about 45 mins. As luck would have it he was not far away on another call. It was about 20 mins. Very nice young man and professional.

reviews.author: Eddie Dent
reviews.text: I just got my truck towed and John was fantastic. The service took a little while but you never know how many calls they have so that's understandable. He was very friendly and made the experience a lot less stressful.

reviews.author: Shandah Naff
reviews.text: DeShawn was my tow truck driver and he was amazing patient kind and communicative. I used freedom towing before, and I would recommend them to anybody!! They’re super fast and all of the technicians and drivers I have dealt with have been professional kind patient people.

reviews.author: Ken Bowden
reviews.text: Called AAA for towing and RONALD from Freedom Towing and Recovery, Newport News, VA arrived at the time promised by AAA. It was a great pleasure to have Ronald assist me with my car. He was so kind, and he has good vibes; nice smile, very polite, and very pleasant looking. I hope I get to see him again the next time I a tow! Thank you , Ronald.

reviews.author: Jamie Munden
reviews.text: This company is the worst! On June 29, our vehicle was hit from behind by a freedom towing vehicle. The police were called, there were no injuries, a report was not filed. We exchanged phone numbers and insurance information. After leaving the scene the driver texted us openly admitting that he was not paying attention as he was on his tablet. We had been stopped for several seconds. Additionally, the driver wanted us to settle this outside of insurance which was declined. The driver gave us false information and is refusing to return calls or answer insurance. This resulted in us being responsible for filing under our insurance and paying the deductible. We have reached out to Freedom Towing several times requesting to speak to a supervisor and have been told they will call us back. We have yet to receive a call back. Freedom needs to take responsibility for the acts that their dishonest employees perform. This is completely unacceptable.

reviews.author: JoAnne Rawls
reviews.text: I have been staying with friends and going home when I need to do something. I was surprised to see a flat tire on my second car when I got there today. Called AAA, and Freedom Towing sent a driver within 10 minutes. Ben was friendly, fast, and competent. He noticed my camera and asked if I would take his picture, so I did. He filled up my spare, and exchanged it for the flat. I was able to continue my planned activities almost uninterrupted. Thanks, Ben!

reviews.author: Shantaneese Barksdale
reviews.text: Very poor experience with this complaint. Particularly truck number 22. A man with a very rude attitude and cause a load of problems and trouble just towing the car simply down the road. It cussed the police being called out and triple a being called multiple times just resolve this issue. They charged $100 initially to get the car. The driver calls after picking up the vehicle to say it’s going to be another $77 because of fees. Unbeknownst to us we had no idea upon talking to triple a of these extra hidden fees. However the driver comes and proceeds to drive off with our vehicle because he doesn’t have change for the extra fee we ended up having to come out of pocket for. He threatens to take the car back to where he towed it from causing more issues. Triple A ended up resolving the issue and lower the fee to $50 however it shouldn’t have been a fee due to the hassle and problems the tow truck driver caused.this is the same company that was contracted out to tow the car in the first place and the damaged our house in the process and have yet to come to and type of resolve. It’s very disheartening in the society today.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Brooks
reviews.text: Called AAA about a dead battery. Deshone from Freedom was dispatched and I was told it would be 1chr. 15 minutes later, he pulled up and fixed everything. I had gotten a new battery from Autozone but could not get it to fit. They had sold me wrong size. He came into very crazy situation, he was calm and helpful without being dismissive. He listened, helped and gave me a 6 year warranty on a correct battery. Got it hooked up and driving. Explained all the ins and outs. Excellent service, could not ask for better.

reviews.author: J Kuener
reviews.text: I’m a AAA member, they sent out tech Ben to assist with a battery issue. Wanted to leave a comment: Ben was so kind and helpful to my son. Tested his battery. Provided info on replacement type, how to replace & store options. Would def reach out again!! Thank you, Ben!!!

reviews.author: LaVonne Watts
reviews.text: My battery was dead, in the garage at home. Called AAA and they sent Josh from Freedom Towing. Within an hour I had new battery and back to normal. Josh was prompt, friendly and very efficient with my battery replacement. Truly a professional. Thanks so much for coming out on this cold day!!

reviews.author: Melissa J
reviews.text: I was stuck on the side of the busy interstate the night before a holiday. Was originally quoted 30 minutes, but I sat their alone for 3 hrs! Once the guy finally he was quite rude, he got right to work, but was very rude! I would NOT recommend them!

reviews.author: G Neuhart
reviews.text: We were helped by a technician, Charles, yesterday from Freedom Towing and Recovery. We locked our car key in the car at Sandy Bottom Nature Park. Charles was professional, competent, careful, and courteous. He got the car opened promptly and without any problems. We are very grateful for Charles’ help. Thank you.

reviews.author: StachSpot
reviews.text: Was the best towing experience Alvin did great he was prompt and very gentle with my car. I recommend this company and give it 5 stars

reviews.author: Chris Harmon
reviews.text: Karen was amazing!!! She was extremely helpful , stayed on the line and put me at ease!!!! Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: David Evans
reviews.text: I was stuck. One call to Freedom Towing and Recovery and I was up and running in no time. It started with Justice who is their excellent triage person. Justice made sure I was safe, evaluated my situation and dispatched Marco to get my car back on the road. Justice called rather than text me to give me Marco's ETA as well as make sure I was still OK. Marco then called when he was 5 minutes away and again as he arrived. Marco was professional and empathetic and checked my well being before diving into repairing the car. He got it running, then performed some safety checks and said to call immediately if I encountered any issues. What a great experience. Thank you Freedom Towing from having great people like Marco and Justice as your front line representatives

reviews.author: Erica Mabine
reviews.text: Was stuck in the packing lot, 32 degrees outside said they would be there 6:10 am I paid them then at 6:30 am I call and she said they wouldn't be able to do anything till after 9 am. So at 9:20 am I call back and nobody will answer the phone and it's now 11:23 am.

reviews.author: Betty Agnew
reviews.text: AAA sent Javon to change my tire and he got there fast and changed the tire even faster! Excellent experience.

reviews.author: Karen Forde
reviews.text: My 2022 Acura ILX battery died. The driver-don't know his name- checked my battery and stated I needed a new one. No problem. He then informed me that my alternator was "bad". I called Freedom to get the driver's name, but the RUDE lady refused to give me his name. Nothing is wrong with my 3-year-old Acura's alternator. Giving customers expensive, inaccurate information is not cool. Not giving the driver's name is not cool either!

reviews.author: Robert Council
reviews.text: I called today to have my car battery tested and jumped. The technician did an excellent job and was very courteous. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jennifer Amick
reviews.text: Dre and his coworker who drove the tow truck were amazing!!! Literally saved the day. The police cadet acted like I wanted to be blocking the road after an accident and Dre found a way to get me to the side of the road and even a ways down the road. His tow truck driver coworker worked magic getting it on the truck despite a crooked wheel. The car is gonna end up being totaled but at least Dre kept us safe and stopped the police cadet from having it towed by their company for extra $$$. He was so nice!!!!! AAA screwed up the dispatch but Dre saved it!

reviews.author: Lee Westergard
reviews.text: The operator called minutes within being dispatched by the Roadside service and arrived in about 30 minutes. Very quick service! They jacked the car up and put the spare on, then identified where the tire injury was. I was back on the road within minutes. The two gentlemen responding were very personable, one of them was obviously training the other. I was impressed with the way the trainer guided his protoge and they took care to not make any marks on the vehicle. They both treated me and the car with professional courtesy.

reviews.author: melanie
reviews.text: Freedom Towing was dispatched to me through my AAA membership. These guys were great. They arrived right on time for the time that I had been promised by AAA. Communication was excellent, much better than most. I received two different calls from the company: the first from their dispatcher to let me know they got my service request from AAA, and the second was from my service technician, Marco, to let me know he was on his way & would arrive in about 15 minutes. When someone has a vehicle emergency, and they might be anxious, this kind of communication is of utmost importance. Marco arrived in a AAA marked truck and in uniform. This gives a positive, professional image. He also provided a few extra tests on some additional components (alternator) that other service providers may not have done. So this business went the extra mile, offering me peace of mind. They quickly had me up & running and back on the road. Exceptional service. I highly recommend Freedom Towing and Recovery.

reviews.author: Jilly Beanz
reviews.text: They've always been very quick and very polite when I've used their services through my AAA roadside assistance. Very responsive with their arrival time so you're not left wondering if assistance is actually on its way. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bianca Blount
reviews.text: I am not sure of the gentleman’s name that help me today with my tire. But he was nice kind and funny. He made a stressful situation relaxing a replaced my tire with a spare in less than 15minutes.

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.text: I called at 8:30am the lady that answered was very nice got me a quote right away and said that I would have a tow driver 30-45mins. The gentleman that came was very professional and showed up about 45 mins after my initial call. All in all cost me $97 very fast and fair. I would definitely recommend others to use them.

reviews.author: Tim Mincy
reviews.text: Outstanding service!!! Karen and the driver Paul were in constant communication with me the entire time. It was a relief experiencing such great service in my time of need. Nobody plans on breaking down but if you are in the greater Hampton rds area, definitely Google freedom Towing. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Tina Guthrie
reviews.text: All i can say is WOW! They were absolutely amazing! It was a Saturday night 11pm, they answered immediately, and the tow truck was there in 20 minutes. Quentin was outstanding, professional, very nice, courteous, best tow driver we have ever had and we have had plenty of them. The price was lower than I expected especially late on a weekend. We would absolutely recommend them and will be using them in the future for our towing needs. Thank you for the excellent service!!!!

reviews.author: Jon M
reviews.text: Explain to the dispatch operator my location and I needed a tow. I told her, I was at the Wawa on Jefferson Ave & Harpersville Rd. I didn’t give her the address, but she said it was okay she would look it up. The operator sent the tow truck driver to the wrong Wawa on Jefferson Ave. I had to pay more than the quoted price for my tow because they charge by the mile. Due to my situation, I had no choice to pay and wait longer for the driver. The driver was great, only the operator is not good at her job.

reviews.author: Flora Chioros
reviews.text: Needed tire service today in the middle of pouring rain. The driver was there when he said he would be and was able to get me back on the road in no time! Appreciate the kind and attentive service!

reviews.author: C Pal
reviews.text: Needed a battery jump today. Called AAA and Ben from Freedom Towing came by and help me with my car. Ben was very professional, polite, knowledgeable and very customer oriented individual. I’ll definitely use Freedom Towing if I ever need help again.

reviews.author: Constant Motion
reviews.text: Jevon was A+. Called AAA because I locked myself out of my car and Jevon with freedom towing showed up very fast, was super efficient and had exceptional customer service.

reviews.author: a Douglas
reviews.text: AAA arranged a tow 16 hours in advance. I gave detailed info of my needs including that car could not be started and I would request to see drivers credential. When driver arrived he demanded keys, made no attempt to id me as the owner. He moved the truck into towing possition, then requested keys again. When I asked to see his Driving license, he retracted the tow bar, took a photo of my car, got into his vehicle, stated " switch drivers" and drove away. It was never clear if there was a communication problem or if he was an unlicensed driver. This experience is independent of prior use of same service. X Driver washington was sent to replace first driver and waited patiently for the resolution and towed me to my destination. Management called to follow up and say that AAA did not give them my notes and gave no explanation for the first driver. They supported their drivers and did right the situation. MR. Washington made sure I was safe and was safe and was polite and personable throughout.

reviews.author: WillIam Slavik
reviews.text: Lorenzo was AWESOME ! Helpful, friendly and completely professional. I hope if I ever have another flat tire (or a breakdown) that it is near Williamsburg so I can call him again ! Thank you - you really saved my day !

reviews.author: Clyde Hardy
reviews.text: The technician was helpful, fast and was done within seven minutes. However, the dispatch team screwed up my Location and sent a different truck to a different place so I had to wait an additional 30 to 45 minutes one interstate 64.

reviews.author: Zender Smith
reviews.text: AAA assigned Freedom Towing & Recovery to tow my vehicle. Was quite pleased with the service, Alvin provided exceptional customer service. Thank you FTR

reviews.author: Dorothy Martin
reviews.text: I had van battery emergency today. Freedom provided quick and friendly service. Kept me posted about when technician would arrive, etc. Talked with me. Explained the issue and installed the new battery. Very pleased with service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Charlene Gale
reviews.text: My battery was DOA. Called AAA who dispatched Freedom Towing to take the call. Being the Friday before Christmas, they said it might take awhile. Sam arrived, assessed my battery and had a battery available, changed the battery and we were good to go. Sam was wonderful!! Can't say enough about him.

reviews.author: Nikelle Bullock
reviews.text: The responder maintained communicated with me and actually arrived a couple of minutes earlier than estimated. He was very friendly but professional. He determined the problem and quickly had my vehicle back on the road. I am grateful for his help today.

reviews.author: Richard Miller
reviews.text: This tow company came about 930 pm, delivering a car to my neighbors house. Fully aware that he did not have the space to drop the car where the owners requested, this driver took it upon himself to destroy my yard by pulling into it several times , almost hitting my home with the truck several times. Permission to even enter MY property was never asked by the driver nor the owner of the car resulting in damage to my property. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: Ali Alrubaye
reviews.text: I was having a very bad day until I called freedom towing. Thank you Azad for making sure this was a smooth process. They even recommended which shop would be the quickest and cheapest to repair my vehicle.

reviews.author: Tristen Thompson
reviews.text: Being in the navy has its ups and downs, sometimes I have to go places with my car where I don’t want to go and early this morning I found my tire was slashed… technician Lamar provided excellent service to my car, he used a floor Jack and took off my tire without an issue. Of course with my luck my spare was also flat, but he was able to fill it with air and get me back on the road for a reasonable price. He responded within minutes of my request, all around excellent towing and roadside assistance. Thanks Lamar and freedom towing.

reviews.author: Kathh Sander
reviews.text: I have a new Acura under warranty but apparently did not turn off the accessory mode after using it. The battery was dead so I contacted Acura. They must have a contract with Freedom for such calls and the driver, Drey, responded. He was outstanding! He not only called to let me know he would arrive in 15 min but I believe he was here in 12. He was professional, kind, knowledgeable and prompt. Fantastic service. I will 100% call Freedom if I need towing or service in the future. Thanks Drey!

reviews.author: Paragon Painting Services
reviews.text: The driver John Mccormack, he was very great. He was very prompt, and we had great conversations. I was impressed! Jon Ronan owner of Paragon Painting Services

reviews.author: B Dickerson
reviews.text: AAA call. Driver was over hour and half late. Then declined the call after arriving because he could not handle the job. Would not recommend for any job

reviews.author: Rainy McIntosh
reviews.text: BEWARE! If you call and make an appointment and expect these people to be there, you may be waiting forever. Only an hour after the scheduled appointment time when I called them did they inform me that they were not going to honor the appointment because they were busy with AAA calls. Would really have been nice to know. If all they’re going to do are AAA calls then they shouldn’t be telling the public, we’ll be there to tow your car. This isn’t an Amazon order that didn’t show up. This ineptitude could really leave someone stranded in a bad way. Book a tow at your own peril. I for one will ensure no one I care about uses this company. Extremely poor form.

reviews.author: M Jones
reviews.text: This was the nicest, most polite and professional tow company I’ve ever dealt with. Prompt service, fair upfront price, no surprises. I’ll definitely use them again if needed! The driver Lamar - top notch.

reviews.author: Shawntell Webb
reviews.text: Great service from the driver/tech. He was very personable and professional. I needed a tow from a dealership and it wasn't a hassle at all. He was quick. He was nearly finished with the drop off before I met him at the location. I didn't catch his name but I remember him saying he was only 5’7 lol Thank you again!

reviews.author: Maria Santana
reviews.text: Scheduled a AAA tow and got handed to Freedom Towing. Absolutely amazing service! Rudolph called ahead, arrived early, and was extremely friendly, careful, and competent. Would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Veronica Brown
reviews.text: My vehicle needed to be towed and I had the pleasure of having Mr. Lamar to tow my car. Mr. Lamar called to let me know that he was on his way and arrived in a timely manner. After reaching my location, he was very professional, asking for id and taking proper measures to get my vehicle onto the flatbed. Once my car was dropped off at the dealership, Mr. Lamar called me again letting me know the dealership had received my vehicle and he gave me the name of the person of whom he left my key with. Excellent service! Thank you again Mr. Lamar!

reviews.author: Jennifer Simmons
reviews.text: Allan towed my husband’s car today. He arrived 6 minutes after we requested the tow through AAA. I can’t say enough nice things about his experience with Allan. He was a professional throughout and was very efficient. He turned a stressful situation into a positive experience and we appreciate him very much!

reviews.author: Smith Julie
reviews.text: My car died close to Newport News City Park after seeing the Christmas lights. We had the whole family (2 kids 6yr and 9 yrs) including the dog in the car and needed to get back to Virginia Beach. Johnie to the rescue! Johnie was sent to jump our car but we were afraid it would die again since it was such a far drive that we had him call a tow truck. The Tow Truck could not transport all of us so we needed an Uber and both my husband and I had issues with internet at the moment. Johnie was able to order us an Uber on his phone which we paid and he waited with us until the Uber and tow truck got to us. The Tow Truck driver was also with Freedom and was nice a personable while driving our vehicle in the rain back to Virginia Beach. But the real hero in this who story was Johnie! I really did save the day on New Year’s Eve!!!

reviews.author: Andrea Williams
reviews.text: They are friendly and easy to conversate with, during a time when you are not enjoying your day due to car issues. They handle random issues that may arise quickly and they have no problem reaching out to you. Hoping I won't need any more assistance but if I do, hopefully they will be dispatched to aide me via AAA

reviews.author: kellen poto
reviews.text: I WOULD LEAVE ZERO STARS IF POSSIBLE! Freedom cancelled our tow saying they showed to location saying we were not there, but they never did. Spoke to dispatcher Alex who said they would call driver back and would call us back with ETA after already having us wait over 8 hours. STILL NEVER CALLED BACK ONLY THEY READ TEXT MSG. I have reached out and they still won’t return the call. I will never attempt to use FREEDOM TOWING again! In business do what you say you are going to do even if it’s just a phone call. IF YOUR TIME IS VALUABLE DON’T WASTE YOURS DOING BUSINESS WITH THEM EVEN IF THROUGH AAA.

reviews.author: D Jones
reviews.text: The young lady in the office gave great customer service. The tow truck driver also gave great customer service, he actually called and gave me an update on his expected arrival time. He made sure my truck was secure. And for where I was going.. the pricing was fair and reasonable. Thanks again for the help!

reviews.author: David Moniot
reviews.text: Driver Rudolph arrived to rescue our vehicle in Newport News on the Interstate and transported us through rush hour traffic to Chesapeake. He was prompt, safe courteous, professional, and adept with the equipment. Could not have asked for a better experience. Well done Rudolph ! You deserve a raise for your expertise and performance !

reviews.author: Leighton Scretchings
reviews.text: BMW was towed to Auto Haus labor day weekend. Driver was professional and knowledgeable. Showed up within an hour.

reviews.author: Kara Dennison
reviews.text: I had two completely different experiences in the course of an hour. The first person came out to check my battery and was hugely helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable. While he wasn't equipped to help me himself, he gave me the info I needed to start getting things taken care of. The second came to tow me to a garage and spent the entire time talking about how much he hates helping other people with their cars. He promised he'd give the garage my info, then called me late at night to ask if I had any comments. The following day, I found out that not only had he not given the garage my info, he'd also managed to start my car upon arrival at the garage. This was a point he failed to mention in his late-night call, and the garage was unable to tell me until I called them asking for an ETA on repairs. I was without transportation for a day for no reason because of this negligence. I wish I could recommend this company based on the expertise and friendliness of the first person, but the second undid any good will the first achieved.

reviews.author: Sam Massey
reviews.text: I was having battery issues with my old jeep on my way home from work late at night and Chris was sent out to assist me via AAA. Chris was extremely honest, knowledgeable, professional, and willing to help and had me back on the road in only a few minutes due to a loose battery terminal.

reviews.author: Cynthia Molina
reviews.text: The tow man was very punctual and helpful. He had very good and realistic reviews to help me choose a good mechanic! You did a great job telling my vehicle to its location. Thank you!

reviews.author: I_isolate_to_recharge I will Live
reviews.text: Lamar was great! He was efficient with removing the vehicle and made sure it wasn’t able to start before he transported the van to Priority Honda.

reviews.author: Katheryne Darrah
reviews.text: I used Freedom today for the first time, had an overheat, didn't want to sit all day trying to get home, so I called AAA. Driver not only called me after getting dispatched, but told me an approximate ETA (~15 minutes) and was right on time. I loved Nick and, unlike most tow companies, the vehicles didn't sound like diesels nor did they look a million years old. 30/10 would use again.

reviews.author: Cassidy Olson
reviews.text: I'm really pleased with the service we received from Alex, seriously above and beyond and very friendly. Thank you so much, I would recommend Freedom for all your towing and recovery needs =]

reviews.author: Rebecca Kelman
reviews.text: I was assigned to Freedom towing by AAA, I had a question, called and spoke with someone who was very professional and was able to answer me right away. The driver came quickly and took wonderful care of us. Thank you!

reviews.author: Michael Jacob
reviews.text: David is the best!! He helped me jumped my car when he was in between calls! Such a great representation of the company! I know have my designated towing company!

reviews.author: Chelsea Brown
reviews.text: Treyyyyy!! Thank you so much! Freedom Towing please give this a man a raise!!! Listen y’all need to go ask for Trey because he gave me so many options and told me so much good information about my car and his response time was so fast within 15-20 mins of my location and was truly professional! I’m so please with y’all service! Thank y’all so much for your help! Y’all are truly deserving of 10/10 starts!!!!

reviews.author: Gregory McClellan
reviews.text: Excellent service! Dispatch was excellent and concise. Driver was friendly and professional! I highly recommend them ! I am well pleased with the service! My car is at home now. Thanks for the good service! Freedom isn't free but it's priceless!

reviews.author: Stephon Bellamy
reviews.text: I locked my keys in the car and reached out to Freedom and they came in a timely manner and Alex got the job done in a few minutes with great customer service. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Melissa Cline
reviews.text: Freedom Towing was dispatched to me through AAA. Not only were they there right on time, but the driver Darian went out of his way to make sure I could roll my windows up by hooking up the battery charger which happened to be the reason it wouldn't start. He was very kind and went above and beyond what he needed to do. Thank you for the excellent service!

reviews.author: Danielle Johnson
reviews.text: Ben, of Freedom Towing and Recovery was prompt and updated me of his ETA.He was extremely professional and courteous. Great asset to company. Flat tire fixed! courteous andprofessioI will request him if ever in need of service when on the Peninsula.

reviews.author: KATIE ROBINSON
reviews.text: "I was in a real panic when I realized I was locked out of my truck. I called AAA and they sent Freedom Towing and the driver, Ben, arrived quickly and was incredibly helpful. He was professional, friendly, and got me back on the road in no time. I was really impressed with his efficiency and calm demeanor, especially since I was feeling so stressed. I highly recommend Freedom Towing and Ben to anyone in need of roadside assistance."

reviews.author: Wendy Stuck
reviews.text: John, with Freedom, took great care of us when our car needed to be towed. Thank you AAA, Freedom and John. It is reassuring to have safe and reliable people help on a hot, sunny, Sunday afternoon.

reviews.author: Lorenxo Dow II
reviews.text: Mr Henry and Freedom Towing are very highly recommended and professional. Mr Hemry represented the tow company very well with great communication, care, safety, and was very courteous. He also made sure I had a safe deoart as well. Top Notch service . AAA member approved

reviews.author: Fayina Blando-Moore
reviews.text: Lamar did an excellent job! I am thankful that he was able to tow my car and was very efficient with the tow job. He is polite, affable, and professional. Great customer service from Lamar!

reviews.author: Samantha Sedlak Hale
reviews.text: John was absolutely amazing! He was quick, friendly, and professional. Highly recommended company and would definitely use them again!!!

reviews.author: Dianne Bowers
reviews.text: John came to my rescue! I drove off and just thought I might have needed to sign something. He was the third responder to my AAA request. He was the only person who knew how to jump start my Prius hybrid. Didn’t take him 5 minutes to have my car started after sitting there 4 hours and 2 other responders couldn’t even tow my car on their flat beds from the crowded parking lot. Once John had my car started I drove off and kept driving to recharge my batteries. Sorry if I goofed not John’s fault.

reviews.author: Monette Dutch
reviews.text: The guy who towed my car, Eagle, was VERY helpful! He volunteered to put the donut on my car, and towed me with no hesitation. He was kind and professional! Thank you so much, Eagle!!!

reviews.author: Kiana Andrews
reviews.text: They were very quick. Got to me within an hour of the service call. I didn’t get the service techs name but he was very polite, changed my flat in less than 10 mins and I was on my way. I highly Recommend.

reviews.author: Tracie
reviews.text: Driver was super friendly and courteous. Time to get to me was shorter than anticipated. Thank you AAA for connecting me with professional service.

reviews.author: Linda Harris-Watson
reviews.text: Freedom Towing for AAA the driver that came to my rescue this morning 4/25/25 was Ben excellent great personality very nice , got me n my car on time. Thks Ben

reviews.author: Unique M
reviews.text: Kyle with freedom towing. Awesome dude. I didn’t know my membership was basic and I was over by one mile and he got it waved. Fast service, great communication and friendly.

reviews.author: Mike Santillanes
reviews.text: Accidentally locked myself out of my car. Called AAA the technician arrived within 15 minutes and he was quick and courteous, we were on our way in just a couple of minutes.

reviews.author: Kay H
reviews.text: I connected with Freedom Towing through AAA when my radiator failed. Darian was very professional and kind, and helped turn it into a not-so-bad day. Thanks!

reviews.author: Mother Zevrah
reviews.text: I have never witnessed a tow truck driver so reckless. Driving a 10,000 pound vehicle 80+ mph, no lights on, while yelling and waving hands. Almost hit two cars due to tailgating. Is this someone you want towing your vehicle? Poor representation of company!

reviews.author: She'Kailah Davis
reviews.text: Lamar was very quick and respectful/sweet when dealing with my car issues. Luckily I was under warranty with Hyundai, but either way AAA was amazing!

reviews.author: Karen Tyranski
reviews.text: Desperately needed towing services and was in a seriously difficult situation. Lamar went above and beyond to help us get out of our situation. Definitely keeping them in my contact list and recommend using Freedom towing for your needs!!

reviews.author: Rob Johnson
reviews.text: To the driver and truck number 73 Service truck license plate tst 1766.. I get that you are in a hurry. But taking a shoulder and running people off on 64 before the Lasalle exit is very unprofessional. You could have been patient and arrived at the same location. As everyone else, just like we did..

reviews.author: Kelli Stutt
reviews.text: They came out within 25 minutes of calling. Very professional and nice . Definitely would use again.had the tire changed within ten minutes.

reviews.author: Angel Zurvalec
reviews.text: One of their drivers cut me off today and flip me the bird. Not to mention drove very aggressively with someone else's car on the back of their truck. I would not trust this company for anything.

reviews.author: jamie hinton
reviews.text: Disappointing, you just see driver of the tow truck flipping others off. I shouldn't be more professional with a labeled vehicle

reviews.author: Jessica F
reviews.text: For the tow truck driver who thought it was okay to drive out in front of me leaving out of Grand Lake Townhomes area in Newport News. Sir i get you are in a hurry to tow someone vehicle but pay attention. And looking over at people like it’s funny is not cool. It could of been an accident!

reviews.author: Don Lovis
reviews.text: I called AAA . Freedom towing was on their way. After waiting 90 minutes, they never called. Called AAA again and finally said it would be 30 minute wait and never apologized

reviews.author: Katheryn Lovell
reviews.text: Extremely satisfied ,especially with Ernest. He was friendly, professional ,knowledgeable and quickly diagnosed & repaired the issue. He really believes is helping the customer!

reviews.author: Zachary Kersh
reviews.text: Henry was awesome. Showed up quickly, replaced our tire quickly, and made great convo throughout. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Stephanie Richtberg
reviews.text: Ben arrived quickly and was very polite and efficient. He made me feel at ease and I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kenny B
reviews.text: Hasan arrived in less than 15 minutes and was very professional, expedient, and friendly. I would recommend Freedom Towing to anyone that needs a tow.

reviews.author: Paris Ross
reviews.text: The men did not perform their work and they left me and my kids stranded in the dark at night and they lied on what happened and I have multiply witnesses and recording of what happened here tonight. I am highly upset … I will never recommend these people ever again!!!!

reviews.author: Patricia Urso
reviews.text: Marco was right on time and jumped my battery.I went to Auto Zone in Lightfoot Va to have my battery have a deep charge for 1.5hrs.He was great Tks

reviews.author: Lenise Carnage
reviews.text: They was willing to come out on a Sunday night during a storm. They are a lifesaver. Update: they lied, the driver never came and I was stuck for hours. Dont ever use them

reviews.author: Dianne Colton
reviews.text: "Chris" arrived in a timely manner and changed my flat tire for the spare, all the while being friendly and knowledgeable with a smile. Great service!

reviews.author: Eric Garcia
reviews.text: BEWARE!!! DO NOT USE . Scam Tow company. Made us wait 4 hours then just didnt pick up the phones anymore. DO NOT USE

reviews.author: Anna M
reviews.text: Ji’Are changed my tire quickly this evening. He was very professional and friendly! I definitely recommend Freedom Towing!

reviews.author: Mark Dorsey
reviews.text: Freedom Towing and Recovery is outstanding. I was stranded and the response time and professionalism was first class.

reviews.author: Malachie Smith
reviews.text: Lamar from freedom towing very pro. Quick and easy load and unloading, very polite. Would recommend.

reviews.author: reyana johnson
reviews.text: BEN WAS SOOOOOOO AWESOME!!!! He came sooooo fast, was very professional, and provided great service!

reviews.author: David Fletcher
reviews.text: Great driver, great service! He even stopped at an accident to call 911! Can’t get much better than that!

reviews.author: Mar H
reviews.text: The BEST service i’ve used in all my life, fast, reliable, and friendly. They’re local and super affordable the cheapest i've found in the area!

reviews.author: Johnna Willtrout
reviews.text: Poor management. They like to single people out and not take responsibility for their own actions and always put blame on someone else. I would not recommend!

reviews.author: Paulus Turner
reviews.text: These guys towed a vehicle for me. The driver went beneath and beyond to make sure I was taken care of.

reviews.author: Sherri Provance
reviews.text: I have watched these steering wheel holders, that like to call themselves "tow truck" drivers. I have to laugh at this I have forgotten mire about towing than they will ever know

reviews.author: lynell marrow
reviews.text: Alvin was just AMAZING !!! He responded to me needing a tow in a very fast and effective manner. Upon arrival he attempted to jump start the battery , offered recommendations and services to help with this headache. He made my horrific night of car troubles a stress reliever!! I would most definitely recommend this employee and company to anyone in need of a tow 10/10!!

reviews.author: Frances Wornom
reviews.text: AAA called Freedom Towing and the nicest guy arrived about 20 minutes later. This was on Colonial Acres Dr in Hampton. Thanks Freedom Towing for being prompt and pleasant!!!
